description.sl: Glava, trebuh in noge: kaj te boli, ko greš k pediatru, in kako to poveš. Babica Rosa vedno vpraša: »Ti kaj manjka?«
description.en: Head, tummy and legs: what hurts when you go to the paediatrician, and how to say it. Nonna Rosa always asks: 'Is something wrong?'
